items.headline: Stocks tumble as Nvidia leads another technology sell-off
items.summary: AI-focused companies led a broad technology sell-off, with Nvidia at the center of market turbulence ahead of a major industry milestone.

items.headline: Fed's Warsh sees risk of stock bust if AI boom disappoints
items.summary: Kevin Warsh warned that the large-scale investment supporting AI and data centers could create broader financial vulnerabilities if expected returns fail to materialize.

items.headline: Wall Street ends sharply lower on AI jitters ahead of Nvidia results and Anthropic IPO
items.summary: Global and U.S. equities weakened as semiconductor shares declined and investors prepared for Nvidia results and Anthropic's expected market debut.

items.headline: Tech drags market as investors brace for Nvidia
items.summary: Schwab reported early technology losses ahead of Nvidia's earnings and noted pressure across AI-related names including CoreWeave, Nebius, Lumentum, Sandisk and SK Hynix.

items.headline: Trading Day: AI jitters slam Wall Street
items.summary: Market weakness was tied to uncertainty around Nvidia, the AI arms race, trade and national-security issues, with major Asian markets also declining.

items.headline: Trump backs campaign to reinstate Nvidia CEO amid leadership scandal
items.summary: The leadership controversy surrounding Nvidia's CEO intensified, adding uncertainty to the company and the wider AI infrastructure investment theme.

items.headline: California sues OpenAI after Hugging Face hack
items.summary: California's attorney general filed a lawsuit alleging that OpenAI misled and endangered users by developing advanced AI models without adequate safeguards.

items.headline: Anthropic IPO and Nvidia earnings become key tests for the AI trade
items.summary: Investor attention centered on Nvidia's upcoming results and Anthropic's expected IPO as tests of whether the AI-fueled bull market can continue.
